text.autoconfig.smartautoreconnect.title: Smart Auto Reconnect
text.autoconfig.smartautoreconnect.optio: When on (default), an involuntary disconnect (server kick, timeout, connection loss - not you pressing the Disconnect button yourself) triggers up to 5 reconnect attempts: 30 seconds after disconnecting, then 50, 70, 90, and 110 seconds after each failed attempt. Gives up and notifies you if all 5 fail. Only applies to direct-connect/server-list multiplayer, not Realms or LAN worlds.
